set.body:
Outcome

Make first- and second-order closure choices explicit scientific types.

Acceptance

- Effect and neural query axes are owner-bound and ordered.
- Within-domain and rectangular pair domains have canonical indexing.
- RDM identity includes geometry, squaredness, centering, normalization, precision policy, partition design, and pair-order protocol.
- Results cannot erase those choices into an unlabeled vector.
set.title: P4B.2: define effect queries, neural queries, pair domains, and RDM estimands
